## Nonclosed ruled S11 restricted construction checked — Xean, 8 October 2026

The [S11 paper](research/papers/S11-nonclosed-ruled-restricted-masses-and-strict-types.tex) computes both optimized masses over every rough representative of an unbounded nonanalytic ordinary type, all intrinsic ambient-ideal traces and the separate all-test Gauduchon subtraction cost. It includes actual infinite first moments and distinguishes pure-pullback mass invariance, a one-sided strict witness and failure of mutual-type strictness on a point blowup. Existing literature and companion mechanisms retain their credit. The original full-companion report stays INCONCLUSIVE; seven complete independent reconstruction proofs and the limited final PASS are retained in the [checked record](research/xean/results/S11-nonclosed-ruled-A-G-checked-result-20261008.json). The unused general L1 coefficient assertion remains unresolved. Two clean local exports and all final pages were checked, with native-tool limitations recorded. This gives 34 checked articles across 28 original IDs and retains 16/41 answered conditional or formulation requests. General S11 remains open. S02, P19 and P06 continue. Earlier mathematics and incoming author work are preserved; no full-book build is performed.
